name: ourwkrp
description: Mobile-first Spotify music catalog — auth, sync, discover, create

scripts.migrate:staging: doppler run -p ourwkrp -c stg_deploy -- bash scripts/ci/wrangler-ci.sh stg_deploy d1 migrations apply ourwkrp-staging --remote
scripts.migrate:prod: doppler run -p ourwkrp -c prd_deploy -- bash scripts/ci/wrangler-ci.sh prd_deploy d1 migrations apply ourwkrp-production --remote --env production
scripts.predeploy:staging: npm run preflight:staging && npm run migrate:staging
scripts.deploy:staging: doppler run -p ourwkrp -c stg_deploy -- bash scripts/ci/wrangler-ci.sh stg_deploy deploy
scripts.predeploy:prod: npm run preflight:prod && npm run migrate:prod
scripts.deploy:prod: doppler run -p ourwkrp -c prd_deploy -- bash scripts/ci/wrangler-ci.sh prd_deploy deploy --env production
scripts.test:bruno: node scripts/seed-local-d1.mjs && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('.test-results',{recursive:true})" && start-server-and-test "npx wrangler dev --port 8787 --var WKRP_ADMIN_TOKEN:bruno-admin-token" http-get://localhost:8787/health "cd bruno/wkrp-api && npx bru run . -r --env wkrp-local --reporter-junit ../../.test-results/bru-api-junit.xml"
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
